newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Diagnostic faces fifth class action.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Diagnostic faces fifth class action.

text.p: A fifth shareholder class action lawsuit has been filed against U.S. Diagnostic Inc, lawyers for the plaintiffs said Friday.

The latest suit was filed by the law firm of Wolf Haldenstein Adler Freeman & Herz LLP and accuses U.S. Dianognostic of failing to publicly disclose that one of its key management officials had pleaded guilty to fraud.
The four previously filed suits raised the same allegations.
Wolf Haldenstein said it filed the lawsuit on behalf of buyers of U.S. Diagnostic's common stock between March 15 to December 23 last year.
U.S. Diagnostic has denied that the official in question, Keith Greenberg, had been co-founder, officer or director of the company and said it would "vigorously defend these lawsuits."

It said Greenberg had worked as a consultant through Coyote Consulting & Financial Services, with which U.S. Diagnostic ended ties earlier this week. U.S. Diagnostic also said it had ended its relationship with Greenberg.
